description: This file provides classes and functions to support unit-testing of logging behavior in Python code, including capturing log messages, asserting expected messages, and configuring logging for tests.

classes.name: TestLogStream
classes.description: A file-like object for capturing log messages during unit tests.

classes.name: LogTesting
classes.description: Supports end-to-end unit testing of log messages, including setup and assertion methods.

classes.name: LoggingTestCase
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase subclass that provides methods for testing log output.

methods.name: assertMessages
methods.description: Asserts that the captured log messages match expected messages and clears the message list.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Configures logging for testing, redirecting logs to a test stream.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Returns the current list of captured log messages.

methods.name: set_logging_level
methods.description: Sets the logging level for the test logger.

methods.name: logMessages
methods.description: Returns the current list of log messages captured during the test.

methods.name: assertLog
methods.description: Asserts that the current log messages match expected messages.
